description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, showing the number and proportion of samples for each category. The chart contains eight slices, representing the categories: NearSameEntity (grey, 6.34%), ObservationAngle (teal, 12.28%), RelativePosition (dark grey, 7.90%), SimilarMaterial (light green, 10.33%), MentalitySimilarity (cyan, 8.67%), SimilarEvent (blue, 8.77%), AppearanceSimilarity (yellow, 8.77%), UsageSimilarity (green, 9.65%), SubEvent (red, 9.74%), Environment (orange, 8.77%), and Layout (gold, 8.77%). Each slice is labeled with the category name and its corresponding count and percentage, displayed inside the slice. The slices appear to be ordered roughly in descending order by their numerical count, although not perfectly. A legend is not present as the labels are directly on the slices.
